                    // Clock logic
                    function updateClock() {
                        const now = new Date();
                        const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: true });
                        const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
                        document.getElementById('clock-time').textContent = timeStr;
                        document.getElementById('clock-date').textContent = dateStr;
                    }
                    setInterval(updateClock, 1000);
                    updateClock();

                    // Live Data Fetch logic
                    async function fetchKioskData() {
                        try {
                            const response = await fetch('/meeting_room_booking/kiosk/data', {
                                method: 'POST',
                                headers: {
                                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                                },
                                body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', params: {} }),
                            });
                            const resJson = await response.json();
                            const data = resJson.result;
                            if (data) {
                                renderDashboard(data);
                            }
                        } catch (err) {
                            console.error("Failed to load kiosk data:", err);
                        }
                    }

                    function renderDashboard(data) {
                        // Update Summary
                        document.getElementById('summary-total').textContent = data.summary.total;
                        document.getElementById('summary-available').textContent = data.summary.available;
                        document.getElementById('summary-occupied').textContent = data.summary.occupied;

                        // Get sections and grids
                        const occupiedSection = document.getElementById('occupied-section');
                        const availableSection = document.getElementById('available-section');
                        const occupiedGrid = document.getElementById('occupied-rooms-grid');
                        const availableGrid = document.getElementById('available-rooms-grid');
                        
                        occupiedGrid.innerHTML = '';
                        availableGrid.innerHTML = '';

                        let occupiedCount = 0;
                        let availableCount = 0;

                        data.rooms.forEach(room => {
                            const isOccupied = room.status === 'occupied';
                            const statusClass = isOccupied ? 'status-occupied' : 'status-available';
                            const statusText = isOccupied ? 'OCCUPIED' : 'AVAILABLE';
                            const statusIcon = isOccupied ? 'fa-circle-xmark' : 'fa-circle-check';

                            let detailsHtml = '';
                            if (isOccupied) {
                                detailsHtml = `
                                    

                                        
${room.current_meeting.purpose}
                                        

                                             ${room.current_meeting.organizer}
                                             Until ${room.current_meeting.end_time}
                                        
                                    
                                `;
                            } else if (room.next_meeting && room.next_meeting.purpose) {
                                detailsHtml = `
                                    

                                        Next meeting:
                                        ${room.next_meeting.start_time}
                                        ${room.next_meeting.purpose} (${room.next_meeting.organizer})
                                    
                                `;
                            } else {
                                detailsHtml = `
                                    

                                         Free all day today
                                    
                                `;
                            }

                            // Amenities Pills
                            const amenitiesHtml = room.amenities.map(a => `${a}`).join('');

                            const card = document.createElement('div');
                            card.className = `room-card ${statusClass}`;
                            card.innerHTML = `
                                

                                    

                                        
${room.name}
                                        ${(room.building || room.floor) ? '' + (room.building ? room.building : '') + (room.building && room.floor ? ', ' : '') + (room.floor ? 'Floor ' + room.floor : '') + '' : ''}
                                    
                                     ${statusText}
                                
                                

                                     Capacity: ${room.capacity}
                                
                                

                                    ${amenitiesHtml}
                                
                                

                                    ${detailsHtml}
                                
                            `;

                            if (isOccupied) {
                                occupiedGrid.appendChild(card);
                                occupiedCount++;
                            } else {
                                availableGrid.appendChild(card);
                                availableCount++;
                            }
                        });

                        // Show/Hide occupied section dynamically
                        if (occupiedCount === 0) {
                            occupiedSection.style.display = 'none';
                        } else {
                            occupiedSection.style.display = 'block';
                        }

                        // Show/Hide available section dynamically
                        if (availableCount === 0) {
                            availableSection.style.display = 'none';
                        } else {
                            availableSection.style.display = 'block';
                        }

                        // Render Upcoming Meetings Timeline
                        const upcomingList = document.getElementById('upcoming-list');
                        upcomingList.innerHTML = '';
                        if (data.upcoming_meetings.length === 0) {
                            upcomingList.innerHTML = `
                                

                                    
                                    
No more upcoming meetings today.
                                
                            `;
                        } else {
                            data.upcoming_meetings.forEach(meeting => {
                                const item = document.createElement('div');
                                item.className = 'upcoming-item';
                                item.innerHTML = `
                                    

                                        
${meeting.start_time}
                                        
to ${meeting.end_time}
                                    
                                    

                                        
${meeting.purpose}
                                        

                                             ${meeting.room_name}
                                             ${meeting.organizer}
                                        
                                    
                                `;
                                upcomingList.appendChild(item);
                            });
                        }
                    }

                    // Initial fetch and schedule every 30 seconds
                    fetchKioskData();
                    setInterval(fetchKioskData, 30000);
